extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: minibus (travel shuttle), approx. 6.0 x 2.4 x 2.9 m (L x W x H incl. roof rack and mirror arms), wheel diameter 0.80 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow body with transparent windows, driver seat, steering wheel and five double seat rows; roof rack with suitcases and a duffel bag, rear ladder; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
